query: 循环经济策略 循环经济策略 衡量企业在减量化、再利用、再制造、闭环管理方面的体系。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的循环经济战略与路线图，在产品设计阶段引入生态设计（Eco-design），有跨供应链的协同回收机制，并建立了量化目标与治理闭环。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的减废或资源利用方向描述，具备部分再利用项目案例，但缺乏顶层战略、量化目标或系统性的供应链协同。 • 0分（不合格）：无循环经济相关披露，或仅有笼统的“节约资源”表述。 循环经济 循环经济路线图 生态设计 可拆解设计 可维修设计 可回收设计 再生材料 循环材料 再制造 工业共生 闭环回收 生产者责任延伸 以旧换新 产品回收计划 circular economy circular economy roadmap eco-design design for disassembly design for repair design for recyclability recycled content circular materials remanufacturing industrial symbiosis closed-loop recycling extended producer responsibility take-back programme 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '循环经济策略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露循环经济战略或路线图？ 是否在产品设计阶段引入生态设计？ 有哪些再利用、再制造或闭环回收机制？ 是否建立跨供应链协同回收？ 是否有量化目标与治理闭环？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“节约资源”；仅有一般废弃物合规处置；仅有植树或公益回收日；仅有用水回用但无产品/物料循环体系；区分：循环经济策略强调减量化再利用再制造与闭环体系；产品回收率是更窄的量化绩效；节水回用只是水资源效率，不能单独代表完整循环经济策略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Our commitment to sustainability and environmental stewardship encompasses all of our business activities. One of the key objectives of the Group's strategy is to reduce the carbon footprint of our business activities in order to maintain a healthy environment for the well-being of business, people and society. The Group has integrated data collection of environmental KPl as part of normal business operations and devised measures to reduce our impact on the environment. The relevant measures are presented in the sections headed "Energy Management" and "Water Stewardship" under "Use of Resources". In our day-to-day operation, our consumption of natural resources of the sales of motor vehicles and other integrated automotive service have minimal impact on the environment. [Content]
The hazardous waste is mainly generated from the sales of auto related products and the provision of integrated automotive services. This includes waste organic solvent (HW06), waste mineral oils (HW08), waste engine oil (HW08), coolant (HW09), waste dyes and paints (HW12), dry batteries (HW23), wasted towels (HW49) grease filters (HW49), spent activated carbon (HW49), and waste barrels (HW49). These wastes are separately collected and sorted according to the National Catalogue of Hazardous Wastes (Version 2021)(《國家危險廢物名錄(2021 年版)》). Then, the wastes are stored in special containers with clear labels for identification which are designed for storage of hazardous materials. ha s e si s s ss e re s it. results.text: The safety of our customers remain our utmost priority. If the Group identifies that the maintenance materials and products may have safety hazards or quality problems, the Group will trace back all affected products as soon as possible in accordance with regulations. The Group will further conduct an investigation to gain a better understanding of the situation to determine whether a recall is necessary. Once the recall is confirmed, the customer service department will be responsible for initiating the recall procedure, supervising the entire recall process, and providing compensation to the affected customers with value-added services and feedback on the extent of the impact. During the Reporting Period, there were no recall of sold or shipped products due to safety and health reasons.
